# Website support

## Documentation and site defects

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nexa-suite/website/issues) when enabled. Include the page or file, reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, browser/environment and validation output without secrets.

## Questions and content

Use GitHub Discussions when enabled. Otherwise open an issue labeled as a question or documentation request.

## Security

Never use a public issue for a vulnerability. Follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

## Conduct

Follow [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Commercial contact

For commercial questions, contact `nexa.business.contact@gmail.com`. No SLA or deployed-service availability is promised through this channel.
